resources.string: Rewards Overlay shows your session totals above the game. Assess Overlay opens the floating item assessment control. Use these buttons to show or hide them.
Adjust OCR scanning, interface and rewards overlay sizes, material notifications, and other preferences here.
Choose currencies, proofs, and keys to track. You can also choose which counters appear in the rewards overlay.
Check monument rewards and tower heights using the built-in community reference pages.
Browse monsters by tier and tap the ones you have found gleaming. Silhouettes turn into full sprites as you mark your discoveries.
Browse Aussie Codex or YACO without leaving FightTracker. Switch between the two sources inside the Codex tab.
This tab shows materials available today and tomorrow. Let us look at the three buttons that help you plan your farming.
Open the material calendar, choose a material, and see its next available dates across your enabled guilds.
Choose which guild rotations to include. The material forecast and availability checks will use your selection.
Select materials to highlight with an aura. Enable material notifications in Settings to receive availability reminders at set hour.
